title: The Man With Two Brains
description: A brain surgeon (Steve Martin) finds true love with a mass of cranial nerve tissue he wishes were his wife's (Kathleen Turner).

title: Collateral Damage
description: A Los Angeles firefighter (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels to Colombia to find the terrorist who killed his wife and son.

title: This Boy's Life
description: A hip 1950s teen (Leonardo DiCaprio) butts heads with his mother's (Ellen Barkin) rude second husband (Robert De Niro).

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

title: Curly Sue
description: A con man (James Belushi) targets a corporate lawyer (Kelly Lynch) and steals her heart with his adorable adopted daughter (Alisan Porter).

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Men Don't Leave
description: An indebted widow (Jessica Lange) sells the family home and starts over with her two sons (Chris O'Donnell, Charlie Korsmo) in Baltimore.

title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: Caddyshack II
description: The snobby president (Robert Stack) of a country club tees off with a self-made man (Jackie Mason) whose daughter wants to join.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: City by the Sea
description: A New York homicide detective (Robert De Niro) searches for his son (James Franco), the prime suspect in the murder of a drug dealer.

title: The Corruptor
description: An NYPD recruit (Mark Wahlberg) and his superior (Chow Yun-Fat) work to dampen the war between Triads and Dragons in Chinatown.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: With Honors
description: The sole copy of a 100-page thesis falls into the hands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) who uses it to blackmail a Harvard student (Brendan Fraser).

title: The Neverending Story
description: Ducking into a bookstore to avoid bullies, Bastian begins reading a book called "The Neverending Story"; he is transported to the novel's magical kingdom of Fantasia where he must help save the land from an approaching darkness known as the Nothing.

title: Love Affair
description: Engaged to others, a man (Warren Beatty) and a woman (Annette Bening) on a plane plan to meet again three months later atop the Empire State Building.

title: Mars Attacks!
description: Martians take delight in incinerating humans in director Tim Burton's sendup of 1950s sci-fi classics.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Two overbearing mothers try to help their daughters win a beauty contest for the title of Dairy Queen.

title: Protocol
description: A Washington waitress saves the Emir of Ohtar's life, launching her diplomatic career and a scandal.

title: Over the Edge
description: A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

title: My Giant
description: A sleazy showbiz agent (Billy Crystal) tries to exploit a very large, gentle man (Gheorghe Muresan) he discovered in a Romanian monastery.

title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
description: To embarrass his rival, a scheming senator (Lawrence Dane) uses nitwit Ohio teens who are invited to a Washington gathering on educational failure.

title: Malice
description: Married New Englanders (Nicole Kidman, Bill Pullman) rent the third floor of their home to a suave surgeon (Alec Baldwin) who gets too close.

title: Death to Smoochy
description: Fired from his children's show, a former star (Robin Williams) tries to kill his replacement, a man (Edward Norton) dressed in a rhinoceros suit.

title: A Prairie Home Companion
description: The creator (Garrison Keillor) of a long-running radio show conducts business as usual while his guests, cast and crew (Meryl Streep, Lindsay Lohan, Kevin Kline) prepare for the final broadcast.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: Best in Show
description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: Grilled
description: Two down-on-their-luck meat salesmen (Ray Romano, Kevin James) land in hot water when their "foolproof" scheme backfires.

title: Before Sunset
description: A novelist (Ethan Hawke) and an environmentalist (Julie Delpy) who met on a train nine years earlier reunite in Paris.

title: State and Main
description: A filmmaker (William H. Macy) copes with a predatory actor (Alec Baldwin), a demanding actress (Sarah Jessica Parker) and a major location problem as he tries to shoot a movie in small-town Vermont.

title: Disorderlies
description: A greedy heir (Anthony Geary) hires three inept, rap-singing orderlies (The Fat Boys) to care for his rich uncle (Ralph Bellamy).

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).
